description: A FUNCTION-ID ... IS PROTOTYPE separate-compilation function prototype (ISO §2023:11.5 Format 2 / §2023:10.6 / §2023:12.3.8). A signature-only unit - LINKAGE-only data division + a header-only PROCEDURE DIVISION (§2023:10.6.2 SR4) - registers a signature but emits no runtime module; a same-name in-group DEFINITION (GR11a) or a separately-compiled sibling assembly is the activation target (§2023:8.4.3.2.4 GR6b -> EC-FUNCTION-NOT-FOUND on absence). LIVE (Phase 4c M2-UDF-3, DEVLOG 624). The IS PROTOTYPE tail is the `prototypePhrase` rule shared with PROGRAM-ID Format 2; below 2002 VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitPrototypePhrase names the edition (0900) on recognition (kb/Work PB894). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 Identification Division is 'IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. PROGRAM-ID. program-name.' (§1985:VI.3.2.1.1), with no FUNCTION-ID and no prototype; the 2002 compilation group adds the function-prototype, 'FUNCTION-ID. function-prototype-name-1 [ AS literal-1 ] IS PROTOTYPE.' closed by 'END FUNCTION function-prototype-name-1.' (§2002:10.5.1), and §2002:11.4.3 GR2 reads 'Function-prototype-name-1 names the function prototype declared by this definition.' §2002:F.1 item 6 lists PROTOTYPE under 'Reserved words. The following reserved words have been added', and §2002:F.2 states the two changes it rests on, its item 106: 'Program prototypes. The interface and characteristics of a program are defined in a program-prototype.' and its item 142: 'User-defined functions. The ability was added to write functions that are activated in a manner similar to intrinsic functions.' 2014 and 2023 keep the rule (§2014:11.5.3 GR2, §2023:11.5.4 GR2) and the format (§2014:11.5.1, §2023:10.6.1).
display: a FUNCTION-ID … IS PROTOTYPE (separate-compilation function prototype)
vcr: M2 UDF catalog (PHASE4_RECONCILIATION M2-UDF-3); 2002 introduction (§2002:10.5.1 function-prototype; §2002:F.2 items 106 and 142)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. FPROTO IS PROTOTYPE.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-X PIC 9(4).
01 L-R PIC 9(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-X RETURNING L-R.
END FUNCTION FPROTO.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMFP1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    FUNCTION FPROTO.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE W = FUNCTION FPROTO(7).
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM VMFP1.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
FUNCTION-ID. FPROTO.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 L-X PIC 9(4).
01 L-R PIC 9(6).
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING L-X RETURNING L-R.
P.
    COMPUTE L-R = L-X * L-X.
    GOBACK.
END FUNCTION FPROTO.
